name: ea-ecommerce-apps
description: Sell more on your Shopify store with the EA apps, from ChatGPT: raise average order value with quantity breaks, bundles and upsells, grow your email and SMS list with spin wheel and discount popups, reduce cart abandonment with a cart drawer and sticky add to cart, and run Black Friday and other sales with countdowns, free shipping goals and free gifts. Also translates your store, adds a currency selector, improves accessibility and SEO, and finds what slows your store down and speeds it up.

interface.longDescription:
Sell more on your Shopify store with the EA apps, right from ChatGPT. Ask how to raise your average order value, grow your email and SMS list before Black Friday, get shoppers who add to cart but don't buy to check out, or why your store is slow, and ChatGPT checks your store's EA apps, suggests what to do based on your own numbers, and prepares the offers, popups and bars as drafts you preview and publish. No EA apps yet? Ask which app fits your goal and get a link to install it from the Shopify App Store, no sign-in needed.

What you can do:
- Increase average order value: quantity breaks, volume discounts, BOGO and buy X get Y, mix and match and build-a-box bundles, frequently bought together, and post-purchase, thank-you page and checkout upsells.
- Convert more visitors: a slide cart drawer with upsells, trust badges and express checkout buttons, a sticky add to cart bar and quick buy, shipping protection and cart A/B tests.
- Grow your email and SMS list: spin to win, scratch card and discount popups with exit intent, WhatsApp consent and an age check popup.
- Run sales and launches: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday and flash sales with countdown timers, low-stock counts, announcement bars and discount codes.
- Reward bigger carts: free shipping goals per country or currency, free gifts with purchase and tiered discounts.
- Sell worldwide and to everyone: translate your store with a glossary, a language and currency selector for your Shopify Markets, an accessibility widget with scans and a statement page (ADA, WCAG, EAA), SEO checks, redirects and alt text, and a faster store: a speed test that finds what slows it down, image compression and lazy loading.

Ask for a store review to get each app's stats with ideas based on your own numbers. Every change is a draft with a preview card that shows what shoppers will see, such as bundle prices after the discount. You publish it with one click, or ask ChatGPT to publish it and confirm, and almost every change can be undone for 30 days; one-time actions, such as running a translation, are marked on the card.

Works with EA Sticky Add to Cart Drawer, EA Bundles & Quantity Breaks, EA Email Popup & Spin Wheel, EA AI Language Translate, EA Accessibility ADA WCAG EAA, EA SEO & Page Speed Optimizer, EA Free Shipping Bar & Upsell, EA Rewards Bar & Free Gifts, EA Announcement Bar Banner and EA Countdown Timer Bar.

Connecting takes one click: sign in with your Shopify store, then click Allow in your Shopify admin. One connection covers every EA app on your store, on every ChatGPT plan. ChatGPT sees totals and settings only, never your customers' personal data, and you can make the connection read-only or disconnect at any time.

Good to know: ChatGPT works through the EA apps installed on your store. It doesn't edit your theme code, send emails or text messages, or manage orders, and checkout upsells need Shopify Plus.
capabilities: Raise average order value with quantity breaks, bundles, BOGO and mix and match
Upsell and cross-sell in the cart, on the product page and after checkout
Reduce cart abandonment with a slide cart drawer, sticky add to cart and quick buy
Grow your email and SMS list with spin to win, exit-intent and discount popups
Prepare Black Friday, holiday and flash sales with countdowns and announcement bars
Add urgency with countdown timers and real low-stock counts
Set free shipping goals per country or currency
Give free gifts with purchase and tiered cart rewards
Offer shipping protection and A/B test popups, bars and the cart
Translate your store, with a glossary and a language and currency selector
Improve accessibility (ADA, WCAG, EAA) with a widget, scans and a statement page
Find what slows your store and fix it (image compression, lazy loading), plus SEO: alt text, redirects, broken links
Store reviews with stats and suggestions from your own numbers
Every change is a preview you publish, and can be undone
Find the right EA app for a goal, no sign-in needed
defaultPrompt: How can I increase my store's average order value?
Help me grow my email list with a spin-to-win popup
Get my store ready for Black Friday: a sale, a countdown and a free gift

positive.description: Find an app to install (works without signing in)
positive.prompt: Which app should I install for a sticky add to cart bar?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_ea_app and recommends EA Sticky Add to Cart Drawer (sticky add to cart bar, cart drawer, quick buy, cart upsells). Without signing in it gives the Shopify App Store install link and says to open the app and click Connect to AI after installing; on a signed-in connection where the app is already installed, it says the app is already on the store (with its admin link) instead of suggesting an install. No prices or plans.

positive.prompt: How did my bundles do last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_stats for bundles with period last_month and reports the review store's Bundles totals (offer views, add-to-carts, orders, revenue) for the Quantity Breaks offer. No customer personal data.

positive.prompt: What should I try next on my store?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists a few concrete next steps for the EA apps installed on the review store, based on its own setup and numbers. No plan or upgrade promotion.

positive.description: Draft a bundle offer with a preview card
positive.prompt: Create a 2-pack and 3-pack deal for The Videographer Snowboard, 10% and 20% off.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Bundles draft and shows the preview card with the 2-pack and 3-pack prices after the discount, plus Publish and Discard. The store does not change.

positive.description: Stage a settings change, then publish on request (undoable)
positive.prompt: Change my free shipping goal to $80 and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Stages unpublished changes on Free Shipping Bar 1 and shows a before and after card ($100 to $80); the live bar keeps $100 until published. Then calls publish_draft with the merchant's words as user_request; ChatGPT asks the user to confirm before it runs. After confirming, the bar shows $80 and the result says the change can be undone (undo_publish puts back $100).

negative.prompt: Export the email addresses of everyone who signed up through my spin wheel.
Show me the bundle stats for another-store.myshopify.com.
What's the weather in Toronto today?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It reads EA app stats and prepares app settings, discount offers and app actions (such as a translation run or an accessibility scan) on the merchant's own Shopify store as drafts; they go live when the merchant publishes them, or when the merchant asks ChatGPT to and confirms.

publication.release_notes: Better answers for merchants who already use EA apps: ChatGPT checks the store's own EA apps first and no longer suggests installing an app the store already has (find_ea_app marks installed apps on a signed-in connection), uses the numbers it already read instead of asking for them, re-checks a draft after a card button click, and lists every draft prepared in one reply on the last card. The speed skill now matches how merchants describe a slow store, and the translation skill reports separately whether a language is published to shoppers and how much of it is translated. No new permissions.
